candidates.description: A scale used to assess the functional status of cancer patients, ranging from 0 (fully active) to 4 (completely disabled).
candidates.extraction_instruction: Locate the mention of 'ECOG performance status' or 'ECOG' followed by a numeric value.
candidates.measurement_definition: The numeric ECOG performance status score recorded in the clinical note (e.g., 0, 1, 2).
candidates.name: ECOG Performance Status
candidates.uncertainty: The full range of 0-4 is standard, but only 0, 1, and 2 are explicitly mentioned in this subset.

citations.quote: Loss of the serine/threonine kinase STK11 (also known as LKB1) is linked to primary resistance to PD‑1/PD‑L1 checkpoint blockade in KRAS‑mutant NSCLC

candidates.description: The presence or absence of a homozygous deletion in the STK11 (LKB1) gene.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Search for 'STK11' in the genomic/molecular testing section and identify if 'Homozygous Deletion' or 'Wild-type' is reported.
candidates.measurement_definition: Positive if 'STK11 Homozygous Deletion' is documented; negative if 'Wild-type' or no deletion is noted.
candidates.name: STK11 Status
candidates.uncertainty: Only one patient in the provided evidence had molecular testing documented for STK11.

limitations: Small sample size of evidence chunks provided.
Genomic profiling data is only available for a subset of patients.
summary: The evidence identifies baseline variables related to patient functional status (ECOG performance status) and specific genomic alterations (STK11 status) in patients with non-small cell lung adenocarcinoma.
